notes.finding: The prose claim 'removing it would flip the native island from slower-than-Numba to ~2.3x faster' is derived from Numba-island mean 145.96us vs C-ENTRY-ONLY mean 62.44us (ratio 2.337). The loader-fixed counterfactual the same section computes (island minus warm ensure_loaded = 0.039s total, ~89-90us/call) implies only ~1.55-1.62x. The 2.3x therefore additionally assumes the ctypes marshalling/validation wrapper (~26us/call) disappears, a stronger assumption than 'loader fixed'. Both underlying numbers are present and correct in the record, so the conclusion is reconstructable, but the sentence overstates the loader-only fix.
notes.repair_if_touched: Rephrase to '~1.6x on the loader-fixed counterfactual; ~2.3x only if the remaining adapter wrapper also vanishes', or cite the two ratios explicitly.

3_methodology_vs_dossier.status: PASS (kernel-entry proof is genuine; derived numbers labelled)
evidence: ACTUAL C ENTRY: n8_02_instrument.py:184-197 wraps the ctypes function pointers by replacing entries[spec] inside lw_native._LIBS[gang][1] after a first load. Production code re-resolves the entry per call (src/solweig_light/backends/native/lw_native.py:230-231: '_, entries = _LIBS[gang]' then 'entries[spec](...)'), so every admitted invocation passes through the wrapper exactly at the function-pointer invocation - one Python frame above the C call, the closest point reachable without editing src/. The 432/96 native_c_entry.f64 counts alongside 432/96 admitted prove interception; this is not resolver-level-only instrumentation.

Default-arm zero is proven on the real gate: native_lw.native_longwave_primary calls _ensure_loaded() before anything else (src/solweig_light/backends/native_lw.py:130); the instrument wrapped _ensure_loaded and lw_native.primary in the default arm WITHOUT loading (n8_02_instrument.py:276-288), so any pipeline-initiated native call would have produced counts. Counts are 0 in both default instrumented runs, corroborated by the uninstrumented production pool entry leaving a fresh scratch SOLWEIG_LIGHT_NATIVE_CACHE empty (filesystem proof through run_utci_tiles worker children). The sys.modules-native-true artifact is explicitly attributed to the instrument, not the pipeline.

Counterfactual labelling: 'counterfactual_loader_fixed_island_b128_s' is named as counterfactual and its derivation is reviewer-reproduced (admitted minus warm ensure_loaded); the B7-60 98304-block extrapolation is separately labelled 'diagnostic only'. See note N1 for the one overreaching prose ratio.
Dense-fallback shapes: none used; measurement_caveats explicitly states no synthetic dense-fallback shape was substituted, and the v7 dense-fallback residual is quoted only as a labelled comparison.

Stage attribution without double counting: stage totals are a nested hierarchy (solweig_calc > lcyl_by_demand > dpc_primary > decode/classifier/island) and are reported as such; the in-Lcyl decode/classifier portions are labelled '_estimated' with the 3-decodes+1-classifier-per-LW-block pattern and recompute exactly (decode: (0.194498/2052)*3*432/0.300185 = 0.4092; classifier: (0.05432/684)*432/0.300185 = 0.1143; dpc residual by subtraction from dpc: 0.2197). The four fractions_of_lcyl sum to 0.953 = dpc/lcyl (dpc does not cover the whole Lcyl wrapper) - correct, though the record does not spell out why the sum is below 1.
Instrumentation overhead measured separately per dossier: wrapper self-test in every counters file (~151-157ns/call) plus instrumented-vs-uninstrumented wall deltas with an explicit noise caveat.
